note: Ramond et al. (2023) established that infantile spasms occurred in 6/12 (50%) and epileptic encephalopathy in 7/12 (58%) of individuals with 5' TRA2B variants, contradicting the >70% frequency claim.

evidence.text: In the initial cohort of 12 individuals with clustered 5' loss-of-function variants in TRA2B, infantile spasms were documented in 6 individuals (50%) and unclassified epileptic encephalopathy in 1 individual (totaling 7/12, ~58%), which does not meet the proposed >70% threshold.

source.title: Clustered variants in the 5′ coding region of TRA2B cause a distinctive neurodevelopmental syndrome
source.quote: infantile spasms in 6 individuals (6/12, 50%) and an unclassified epileptic encephalopathy
